items.title: Colon section annotated with a small-intestine list
items.text: Sample 167799 is sigmoid colon (its metadata, organ Colon), but it was annotated with the refined small-intestine list. 'Enterocytes' are colonocytes: CEACAM7 90%, AQP8 66%, CLCA4 56%, while APOB (13%), MGAM (5%) and CD36 (2%) are barely detected. 'Villus fibroblasts', Paneth cells and M cells do not fit the colon (no villi; Paneth cells excluded by your prior U-1). Annotate it again with a colon list, starting from the built-in colon list pruned to this panel.

action.request: Draft a colon marker list for sample 167799 from organ_marker_draft(organ='colon', sample_id='167799'), check it and save it for Markers...

check.reason: Holds: the sample is sigmoid colon, and the small-intestine absorptive markers are barely detected while colonocyte genes dominate.
check.evidence: sample_context organ Colon (metadata 'Sigmoid colon'); review_markers Enterocytes: APOB 13%, MGAM 5%, CD36 2% vs top genes CEACAM7 90%, AQP8 66%, CLCA4 56%, TMIGD1 89%.

items.title: Lamina propria macrophages are hidden in 'Villus fibroblasts'
items.text: A sub-cluster of 794 'Villus fibroblasts (telocytes)' carries macrophage genes (MPEG1 63%, MS4A6A 64%, DNASE1L3 55%, CSF1R 38%, C1QC 43%) and its cells sit together (spatial clustering 2.0). Meanwhile the labelled Macrophages lie a median 557 um from the epithelium, which leaves the lamina propria, where most colonic macrophages live, almost without them. Give Myeloid sharper markers (e.g. MPEG1|MS4A6A) in the colon list, so these cells go to Macrophages.

check.reason: Holds: a cohesive macrophage-gene sub-cluster sits inside the fibroblasts, and almost no macrophages are labelled in the lamina propria. Rates (MPEG1 63% vs 17%) are too high for plain spillover; even if some cells are doublets, the colon list should sort them.
check.evidence: type_structure Villus fibroblasts /2: 794 cells, MPEG1 63%, MS4A6A 64%, DNASE1L3 55%, C1QC 43%, spatial clustering 2.0; spatial_profile Macrophages distance to epithelium q25/median 217/557 um.

items.title: Goblet cells over-called: colonocytes and crypt-base cells inside
items.text: Goblet cells are 42% of the epithelium (5,695 cells), well above the about 23-25% expected in the human colon (COL-04). Two of their sub-clusters are other cell types: 1,278 cells with CA1 86%, SLC26A3 72% and CD177 (surface colonocytes, spatial clustering 3.1), and 1,553 with ASCL2, CDCA7 and STMN1 (crypt-base stem/TA cells; Stem/Goblet confusion 0.33). ITLN1 is in 69% of the other epithelial cells. In the colon list, drop ITLN1 from Goblet cells and keep the colonocyte type (CA1, SLC26A3, AQP8, CEACAM7).

check.reason: Holds: two goblet sub-clusters are colonocytes and crypt-base cells, and the goblet share is far above the expected share (COL-04).
check.evidence: Goblet 5,695 of 13,578 epithelial (42%); type_structure Goblet /3 1,278 cells CA1 86% vs 13%, SLC26A3 72% vs 7%, clustering 3.12; /0 1,553 cells ASCL2, CDCA7, NOS2; type_confusion Stem/Goblet 0.33; ITLN1 69% in siblings.

items.title: BEST4+ cells over-called
items.text: Of the 770 'BEST4+ enterocytes', only one sub-cluster of 170 cells carries the type's genes (BEST4 86%, OTOP2 72%, SPIB 88%, CA4); the other 600 show none of them (BEST4 in 28% of the whole type). Require two of BEST4, OTOP2 and SPIB (or a negative colonocyte marker) in the colon list so ordinary colonocytes stay out.

check.reason: Holds: only 170 of 770 cells carry BEST4/OTOP2/SPIB; the other ~600 have BEST4 in about 12%.
check.evidence: type_structure BEST4+ /1: 170 cells BEST4 86%, OTOP2 72%, SPIB 88%; /0 and /2 (600 cells) have no BEST4-type genes; BEST4 28% over the whole type.

items.title: Strong epithelial spillover next to the crypts
items.text: 59% of non-epithelial cells within 10 um of the epithelium carry epithelial markers (28% at 10-30 um, 10% beyond 60 um), and 'Villus fibroblasts' detect EPCAM in 53%. That inflates mixed calls in the lamina propria; keep EPCAM- negatives on immune and stromal types and do not use EPCAM as a positive marker outside Epithelial.

check.reason: True but it changes nothing: the list already uses EPCAM- on immune lineages and no EPCAM positives outside Epithelial; the fixes of H2-H3 cover its consequences.

items.title: The layout fits the colon priors
items.text: Epithelial cells stay in the mucosa (21 out-of-place cells, COL-01), neurons lie deep (median 521 um from the epithelium, COL-11), ICC sit with smooth muscle (COL-12), lymphatics lie below the mucosa (median 260 um, COL-13) and plasma cells hug the crypts (COL-06). Smooth muscle between the crypt bases is muscularis mucosae (A3, A6), common in diverticular disease (COL-10 exception).

check.reason: Correct, but it is a confirmation with nothing for you to do; the out-of-place smooth muscle areas were already closed as false alarms in the area review.
